blends.name: Chosen One - Max
blends.desc:
In a magical kingdom ruled by cats, each cat possessed a unique magical power. But a powerful sorcerer stole their magic, leaving the cats feeling powerless. An elder cat named Max discovered a way to combine their remaining magical energy to create a new, even more powerful magic.

But in order to create this new magic, Max needed the help of the cats. He put out the call to all the cats in the kingdom, asking them to blend their three chosen ones in order to create a new, more powerful one that would restore their magic and save the kingdom.

The choice is yours - will you sacrifice the chosen ones to create a brighter future for all the cats of the kingdom?
